name: vyra-platform
description: Vyra — short-video social platform. Mobile app, Super Admin panel, backend and ML services.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mobile install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.typecheck: npm run mobile:typecheck && npm run admin:typecheck && npm run backend:typecheck
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix admin ci && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix backend run migrate:up && npm --prefix backend run preflight
